note: PredicateStatus::as_str() writes 'partially_applied' into payload_json's status key (via json_set before, read-modify-write now), but the payload's serde round-trip expects camelCase 'partiallyApplied' — after update_predicate_status(PartiallyApplied), list_operations silently drops the row (serde_json::from_str fails and the op is skipped). Latent since Phase C; preserved bug-for-bug by the ADR-036 port (see plan_repo.rs update_predicate_status comment + pinning test).

sample_operations() reads cleanup_plan_operations.sample_ids_json, but save()/append_operations() never write that column (sample ids only live inside payload_json) — the method returns empty for every plan persisted through the repo. Pinned as current behavior by sample_operations_reads_column_save_never_populates; fixing means writing PlannedOperationPredicate.sample_email_ids into the column at insert (and deciding backfill).
